purpose: Preserve the wholesome title/menu art artifacts generated or derived during the 2026-06-19 visual session.
note: The raw image-generation previews were not exposed as pristine saved files by the tool. This archive saves every usable image artifact that existed on disk: the clean preview screenshot, the final live assets, crop variants, inpaint experiments, and rejected visual references.

usage_guidance: Use live-assets/ or public/assets/backgrounds/title-wholesome-*.webp for the current shipped title screen.
Use source-previews/clean-generated-preview-screenshot.png as the visual reference if regenerating a pristine high-resolution source later.
Do not use public/assets/title-screen.png raw as a background because it contains baked title/menu text and translucent artifacts.
If replacing the live art later, generate true art-only 16:9 and 9:16 assets with no text, logo, UI panels, buttons, translucent rectangles, or placeholders.
